project_goal: Evaluate lightweight deep learning models for intent classification and out-of-scope (OOS) detection on the CLINC150 dataset.
project_framing: Comparison of a sparse-feature baseline (TF-IDF + MLP), a convolutional sequence model (Text CNN), and a recurrent sequence model (BiLSTM).
key_finding: Focus on improving OOS detection and addressing semantically ambiguous intent pairs within the same domain. Consider intent merging for persistently confused pairs and confidence thresholding for high-confidence errors.
